title: Orbit of the split step
statement: For every Boolean word $w$, every natural number $i$ with $i\le |w|+1$ satisfies: iterating the split step determined by $w$ exactly $i$ times from the empty word yields the word consisting of $i$ copies of $\mathrm{true}$.
